'
Igginbottom's Wrench
is a studio album by the band
'Igginbottom
, released in 1969 through
Deram Records
originally on
vinyl
only.
It has been reissued a number of times (sometimes under the group title of "Allan Holdworth & Friends"), most notably on CD for the first time on 5 March 1989, as well as a
remastered
edition in 2000 through Angel Air Records with extensive liner notes detailing the band's history. It is one of the first recordings to feature guitarist
Allan Holdsworth
.
